headline: Curry hurts abdomen as Rockets end Warriors' eight-game streak

top.headline: Curry hurts abdomen as Rockets end Warriors' eight-game streak
top.summary: Stephen Curry left about six minutes into Golden State's 115-108 loss at Houston and had an MRI that night. Steve Kerr said Curry "tweaked something in his abdominal area" and that "concern is high, but I have no idea the extent of the injury." His status for Friday against San Antonio depends on the results.

top.headline: Schlittler and Misiorowski win Cy Young unanimously
top.summary: The Yankees' Cam Schlittler took the AL award with all 30 first-place votes, ahead of Dylan Cease, Parker Messick and Drew Rasmussen. The Brewers' Jacob Misiorowski was also unanimous in the NL after leading the majors in ERA (1.80), strikeouts (252) and opponents' average (.157). Louis Varland and Mason Miller won the first BBWAA Reliever of the Year awards.

top.headline: McDavid's season-opening point streak hits 20 as Oilers beat Flyers in OT
top.summary: McDavid had an assist in a 3-2 win, and Evan Bouchard scored 47 seconds into overtime. McDavid is the fourth player with a point in each of a season's first 20 games, joining Wayne Gretzky, Mats Sundin and Dany Heatley. He leads the league with 49 points, and Edmonton is 14-3-3.

leagues.name: NFL
leagues.summary: Commanders at Giants on TNF; Vikings won't commit to Cousins yet; Darnold out as Mendoza makes first start; Rams keep Nacua off IR

stories.headline: TNF: Commanders at Giants
stories.summary: Washington (2-5-1) visits New York (5-2-1) tonight at 8:15 ET on Prime Video, a rematch of a 27-27 Week 5 tie. J.J. McCarthy has won six straight starts for the Giants, and Arvell Reese was named NFC Defensive Player of the Week after three sacks against the Eagles. Jayden Daniels practiced fully all week with a left elbow injury.

stories.headline: Vikings won't commit to Cousins as Week 10 starter
stories.summary: Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday it's "still too early to commit wholeheartedly" to Kirk Cousins starting Sunday against Green Bay, a day after Minnesota traded for him. If Cousins doesn't start, Kyler Murray, who sat Week 9 with hamstring tightness, is the expected option.

stories.headline: Darnold out; Lock expected to face Mendoza and the Raiders
stories.summary: Seattle ruled out Sam Darnold (rib, quad) for Week 10, with a return possible in Week 12 after the bye. Drew Lock, limited in practice with elbow and quad injuries, is expected to start in Las Vegas against No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza, who makes his first NFL start after the Raiders traded Cousins.

stories.headline: Rams keep Puka Nacua off IR; Davante Adams eyes Week 13
stories.summary: Nacua sprained his MCL and PCL and has turf toe from one play in Week 9. The Rams will go week to week instead of using IR, though he could miss about four games. Sean McVay pointed to the Dec. 3 game against Kansas City as a possible return for Adams after hamstring surgery.

stories.headline: Saints open Travis Etienne's practice window
stories.summary: New Orleans designated Etienne to return from IR and he was limited Wednesday; Kellen Moore said there is "some potential" he plays this week. Center Erik McCoy (biceps) is out, so Cesar Ruiz moves to center.

leagues.name: NBA
leagues.summary: Curry leaves with abdominal injury; Spurs win 10th straight; Blazers beat Thunder again; Lakers win seventh in a row

Steve Kerr said Curry "tweaked something in his abdominal area" and that "concern is high, but I have no idea the extent of the injury." His status for Friday against San Antonio depends on the results.

stories.headline: Spurs erase 22-point hole for 10th straight win
stories.summary: San Antonio came back from 22 down to beat Chicago 124-119. Victor Wembanyama had 32 points, 9 rebounds and 5 blocks, and Dylan Harper added 18 points and 10 assists. The Spurs are 10-2; the Bulls are 1-9 and have lost eight straight.

stories.headline: Trail Blazers beat Thunder for second straight night
stories.summary: Portland won 118-108 a night after a 123-103 win, sweeping the two-game set. Deni Avdija scored 28 and Damian Lillard had 18. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored a game-high 31.

stories.headline: Lakers win seventh straight; Bucks lose eighth in a row
stories.summary: Luka Doncic scored 32 as the Lakers won 123-112 in Milwaukee to move to 11-2. Sandro Mamukelashvili added 23. The Bucks are 1-11.

stories.headline: Harden's season high ends Knicks' four-game run
stories.summary: James Harden scored a season-high 32, including a go-ahead 3 with 4:21 left, as Cleveland won 115-107 at Madison Square Garden. Karl-Anthony Towns had 21 and 11, tying Willis Reed's franchise record with his 11th straight double-double to open a season.

standouts.name: Franz Wagner
standouts.note: Tied his career high, his third straight 30-point game, as Utah lost its 10th straight.

standouts.name: Victor Wembanyama
standouts.note: Led the comeback from 22 down for San Antonio's 10th straight win.

standouts.name: James Harden
standouts.note: A season high, capped by the go-ahead 3 at MSG.

Timberwolves adding Johni Broome on a two-way deal
Lakers waive two-way C Lawson Lovering

leagues.name: NHL
leagues.summary: McDavid's point streak reaches 20; Predators win sixth straight despite Gauthier; Kucherov and Carlson lead 8-3 rout in Buffalo

stories.headline: McDavid's season-opening point streak hits 20 as Oilers beat Flyers in OT
stories.summary: McDavid had an assist in a 3-2 win, and Evan Bouchard scored 47 seconds into overtime. McDavid is the fourth player with a point in each of a season's first 20 games, joining Wayne Gretzky, Mats Sundin and Dany Heatley. He leads the league with 49 points, and Edmonton is 14-3-3.

stories.headline: Predators win sixth straight as Gauthier scores again
stories.summary: Nashville won 4-2 at Anaheim for its first six-game win streak since March 2024. Cutter Gauthier has 14 goals during a seven-game goal streak, the first to reach that total since Mario Lemieux and Alexander Mogilny in 1992-93. Roman Josi reached 800 career points.

stories.headline: Kucherov hat trick, Carlson five points in Lightning rout
stories.summary: Tampa Bay won 8-3 in Buffalo. Nikita Kucherov's natural hat trick was his eighth, tying Martin St. Louis for second in franchise history, and John Carlson reached 800 points. Erik Cernak left after crashing into the glass.

stories.headline: Mammoth injuries pile up in loss to Golden Knights
stories.summary: Utah lost 5-3 at Vegas, and Nick Schmaltz left in the first period with a lower-body injury. Dylan Guenther and Nate Schmidt went on IR. Utah has lost three straight; Vegas has won four in a row.

standouts.name: Nikita Kucherov
standouts.note: All three goals came in the third period.

standouts.name: John Carlson
standouts.note: His assist on Kucherov's third goal was his 800th point.

standouts.name: Sergei Murashov
standouts.note: Kept Pittsburgh in it for a shootout win in San Jose.

Canucks place F Ilya Safonov on waivers

The Brewers' Jacob Misiorowski was also unanimous in the NL after leading the majors in ERA (1.80), strikeouts (252) and opponents' average (.157). stories.headline: MVP winners announced tonight
stories.summary: The BBWAA announces both MVPs at 7 p.m. ET on MLB Network. AL finalists are Yordan Alvarez, Junior Caminero and Bobby Witt Jr.; NL finalists are Pete Crow-Armstrong, Shohei Ohtani and Brice Turang.

stories.headline: Skubal market widens; Padres expected to meet him
stories.summary: The Mets, Dodgers, Padres and Blue Jays have known interest in Tarik Skubal, and San Diego is expected to meet with his camp in the coming days. ESPN's Jeff Passan reported Skubal has no interest in a shorter, higher-dollar deal.

stories.headline: GMs say 'business as usual' as lockout looms
stories.summary: The GM meetings in Las Vegas wrapped with the CBA set to expire Dec. 1. Yankees GM Brian Cashman said he is "approaching business as usual here until told otherwise."

moves.text: Padres sign RHP Ryan Weiss to a major league deal
Twins sign Jose Espada; Phillies sign Bryan Ramos and Brian Navarreto (minor league deals)
